full_prompt_en: A square loosely painted urban scene shows a lone man from behind on a blue-toned street, looking toward a yellow and pale blue apartment building. The building occupies the upper center, its tall facade broken by small balconies, windows, and a dark doorway at street level. Warm yellow light spreads over the right side of the facade, while cool blue washes cover the left and the adjoining structures. Near the base of the building, a dark vintage-looking car stands beside the curb, its roof and wheel shapes outlined in quick strokes. The man occupies the lower left-center, wearing a long dark coat and brimmed hat. His hands appear tucked near the coat sides, and his feet are set apart on the pavement, giving him a still, watchful posture. A pale vehicle or large light shape is partly cropped along the far left, and broad blue shadow crosses the road in front of him. The street itself is suggested through horizontal color blocks and a few loose perspective lines rather than precise paving. Thin ink-like marks describe balcony rails and window frames, while transparent blue watercolor-like areas bleed into one another around the edges. Orange at the entrance and warm ocher on the wall punctuate the otherwise cold palette. Daylight seems to fall from the upper right, brightening the yellow facade and car roof, with the foreground figure remaining in shadow. The overall composition sets a dark solitary silhouette against a luminous building, balancing sketchy urban detail with open blue space.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形松动笔触的城市画描绘一名独自男子以背影站在蓝调街道上，望向一座黄与浅蓝色公寓楼。建筑占据上方中央，高立面由小阳台、窗户和街面深色门洞打断。暖黄光铺在立面右侧，冷蓝色洗覆盖左侧及相邻建筑。在建筑基座附近，一辆深色、带旧式外形的汽车停在路边，车顶与车轮形状由快速笔触勾出。男子位于左下偏中央，穿深色长外套、戴有檐帽。双手似收在衣服两侧，双脚分开踏在路面，使姿势静止而警觉。左缘有一辆浅色车或大型浅色形状被部分裁掉，宽阔蓝色阴影横过他前方道路。街道通过水平色块和几条松动透视线暗示，而非精确铺地。似墨的细线描绘阳台栏杆与窗框，透明蓝色水彩般区域在边缘互相渗合。入口处的橙色和墙上的暖赭色点断其他冷调。日光似从右上方落下，照亮黄色立面与车顶，前景人物仍处于阴影。整体构图把深色孤单剪影置于明亮建筑前，在草绘城市细节与开阔蓝色空间之间取得平衡。
style_prompt_en: The image has a loose watercolor-and-ink urban painting finish, with transparent washes, quick linework, and partially unresolved edges. Cool cobalt, cyan, and slate blue occupy broad areas, while smaller yellow and orange zones provide a warm focal contrast. Thin structural marks hold selected edges in place, but neighboring planes bleed, scrape, or fade into pale paper. A dark vertical silhouette anchors the lower field against larger, luminous color blocks. Soft daylight brightens one side of the composition and leaves the foreground relatively subdued. Broken horizontal strokes suggest ground and reflection without exact geometry; stacked verticals create an understated perspective rhythm. The overall effect is solitary, atmospheric, and vividly economical.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有松动的水彩与墨线城市绘画质感，带透明色洗、快速线条和部分未完成的边缘。冷钴蓝、青蓝与石板蓝占据宽阔区域，较小的黄橙色域提供暖色焦点反差。细结构线稳住选定边缘，相邻平面则渗开、擦过或淡入浅色纸面。深色竖向剪影在较大明亮色块前稳住下部。柔和日光照亮构图一侧，前景相对低调。破碎水平笔触暗示地面和反光，却不精确刻画几何；层叠竖线形成含蓄透视节奏。整体效果孤独、富大气感，并以简练手法呈现鲜明色彩。
theme_en: A lone man on a blue-toned street facing a yellow building
theme_zh: 蓝调街道上独自面对黄色建筑的男子
name: Jacques Monory
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
